Privacy policy

What happens to the information you send me, how long I keep it, and your rights.

1. Data controller

Alexandre Poquet, Alex & Lia, 08460 Signy-l’Abbaye. Contact: the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/contact/).

2. The data I collect

  • Contact or quote request: your name, your email, your phone number if you give it, your choices in the configurator (type of website, plan, options, domain name) and your message.
  • Online order: first name, last name, email, phone, postal address, business name, your choices, the domain name you want, your message and any referral code. The postal address is used for the invoice and to register the domain name.
  • Client area: your login details, your change requests (text and photos) and the date of your last login.
  • Payment: I never receive your card number or your IBAN (see point 4).

3. Why I use it

To reply to you and prepare your summary. To carry out your order: create the website, register the domain name, manage the plan and the requests. To issue invoices and keep them for the period required by law. Nothing else: no advertising, no reselling, no profiling.

4. Payment by Stripe

Payments are handled by Stripe, a payment provider. When you pay, you enter your bank details on a secure Stripe page. They do not pass through my website and Alex & Lia never stores them. I only receive the payment status (successful, pending, declined) and the matching invoice. Stripe processes this data under its own privacy policy, available at stripe.com/fr/privacy.

5. Domain name

When you check a domain name, the name you type is sent to the official registry for the extension using the RDAP protocol: AFNIC for .fr, Verisign for .com and .net, PIR for .org. This check runs from your browser while you type, then from my server when you order, to confirm availability. Only the name searched for is sent.

To register the domain name, I pass your registrant details (first name, last name, address, email, phone) to the registrar and to the extension’s registry. This is required for the domain name to be registered in your name. As a rule, an individual’s details are not published in the registry’s public directory.

6. Client area and accounts

Your account is created automatically when you order, with your email address. Requests sent from the client area (text and photos) are only used to make the requested change. To work faster, I may use artificial intelligence tools; I check everything before it goes live.

An account with no login for 12 months and no active plan is deleted automatically, along with the requests and photos it holds. An email warns you 30 days before. Just log in to keep it.

7. How long I keep data

  • Requests that went no further: 3 years after the last exchange.
  • Orders and customer accounts: for the whole relationship, then 5 years for contract documents and 10 years for invoices, as the law requires.
  • Inactive accounts: deleted after 12 months with no login and no active plan (point 6).

8. Recipients

Your data is intended for Alex & Lia only. It passes through the website host, o2switch, 222-224 boulevard Gustave Flaubert, 63000 Clermont-Ferrand, France, +33 4 44 44 60 40, www.o2switch.fr, through the mail service that receives requests, through Stripe for payment and through the registrar for the domain name. It is never sold or transferred.

9. Cookies and local storage

This website uses no advertising trackers and no audience measurement tools. It sets no cookies until you log in to your client area.

  • If you arrive through a referral link, the referrer’s code is kept for 60 days in your browser’s local storage, to prefill it in the order form. It is only sent with your order.
  • When you log in to the client area, a login cookie is set. It is needed for the service and is only used to keep you logged in.

10. Your rights

You can ask to access your data, correct it, delete it or get a copy, and object to its processing, by writing through the contact form (https://www.aled08.fr/contact/). I reply within one month. You can also contact the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

Last updated: 14 November 2026.
